effect_description_eng:
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 level 4 card with [Pulsemon] in its text from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, activate 1 of the placed card's [When Digivolving] as an effect of this Digimon.
[Your Turn] While you have a Tamer, this Digimon gets +3000 DP.
